correctness.rationale: Using the signed edge incidence B with columns oriented from A to B, the real-lift force is B diag(w) sin(Bᵀθ). The mean is conserved; the class-constant difference map is d↦d+hΛ sin d. The two distinct points exchange since 2δ/sin δ is strictly increasing from 2 to infinity. The positive vector taking values d_A and d_B on the two classes is Perron for the signless Laplacian, similar to L, so the positive quotient spectrum is bounded by Λ. The two Jacobians are I−h cos(δ)L; squaring gives the claimed trichotomy using 0<2δ cot δ<2 on (0,π/2). At criticality the centered component maps are I+Q and I−Q through cubic order, with Q=(h/2)B diag(w)(Bᵀu)^2 (entrywise square). Their composition retains −DQ·Q=−∇W at cubic order because DQ is symmetric. One color's components are positive sums of squares, so Q=0 forces equality across every edge, hence u=0 in the mean-zero slice. Homogeneity gives the stated decrease of squared radius and two-sided positive bounds on each increment of its reciprocal; local invertibility excludes finite-time landing. This proves the rate near the chosen p_+ (near p_- the even subsequence instead limits to p_-). On the scalar circle Q is π ε²/2, yielding cubic coefficient −π²/2 and reciprocal-square increment tending to π². The analytic reconstruction covers every graph in scope; the frozen finite diagnostics were inspected, not used as an infinite proof or executed.
